Start working with your new job at Giant in Lelystad next week! Here you can use your technical skills. You have guaranteed hours and will work full-time! Yes! You earn €17.30 per hour. You can earn allowances up to 50%. There are plenty of opportunities for growth at Giant. Are you doing well? Then you can work at Giant for longer period of time and there is a chance of takeover! Sounds good? Apply immediately as a warehouse worker!

What we offer
- Hourly wage €17.30
- Travel allowance up till 40 km
- Nice team with enthusiastic colleagues
- Free hot meal, fresh fruit, coffee and tea
- Chance of takeover

Who you are
As a warehouse worker it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- You are available from Monday to Friday. Saturday is optional
- You are full-time available from 7:00-16:00
- You can speak English because you will be working at an international company
- You have technical knowledge. You can handle tools
- You live in Lelystad area, or you have your own transportation to get here

What will you do
When you arrive at Giant in the morning, you discuss the day with your colleagues. This while enjoying a nice cup of coffee in the canteen. When it is time, you walk to your department and the team leader will tell you what the targets are for the day. Then you and your team will assemble bicycle parts. Each warehouse worker has his own place and task on the production line. For example, you ensure that the electric motor is installed and your neighbor ensures that the brake cables are pulled! All this happens at a fast pace, so it is important that you perform your task well so that the line can keep running! Together you ensure that the most beautiful and newest Giant bicycles can be delivered to the customer, how cool is that!

Where will you work

As a Cleanroom Operator, you play an important role in maintaining the quality of high-tech products used in industries such as semiconductors and electronics. You will work in a controlled cleanroom environment where accuracy, safety, and quality are essential.

Your daily tasks include:

- Cleaning high-tech components according to cleanroom procedures and work instructions.
- Performing assembly work using hand tools and technical drawings.
- Inspecting products and carrying out quality measurements.
- Preparing and cleaning metal frames and packaging materials according to protocol.
- Reporting deviations and registering quality findings in the production system.
- Reading and following technical drawings and work instructions accurately.
- Keeping your workplace clean, safe, and organized according to cleanroom standards.

Working hours

You will work from Monday to Friday in a 2-shift schedule:

- Morning shift: 06:00 – 15:00
- Evening shift: 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts. Overtime on Saturdays or Sundays is paid at 150% when applicable.

Required

- Good command of the English language.
- Ability to read technical drawings and work instructions.
- Technical insight or experience within a production environment.
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule.
- Living in or within travelling distance of Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, or Valkenswaard.

Preferred

- Experience working in a cleanroom environment.
- Experience with assembly work or high-tech production.
